jess: Heads-up — saw prefill latency spike on canary with FP8 kernels when sequences > 8k. 95p went from 220ms -> 420ms. Not in int8 path.

raj: Did you repro locally? any flamegraphs?

marta: I profiled a 16k run, top lines: CPU stall on kv-evict + memcpy thrash; GPU kernel time increased due to extra dequant steps. snippet:
```
perf top: kernel_memcpy 40%, fp8_dequant 30%, kv_lookup 20%
```

lee: Suspect microbatch recompute causes KVCACHE churn. Batching heuristic pushes too many small prefill batches + flush between requests. Proposal: hold kvcache for short tail (200ms) and merge incoming prefill microbatches within 50ms window.

jess: Can we pin to hybrid-int8 for canary to avoid regression? Need rollback plan.

perfbot: regression detected on trunk @commit abc123 — prefill p95 +90% on longctx-fp8 profile. Tagging eng-runtime.

marta: quick trace: `/srv/bin/runtime --profile longctx --seq 16384 --quant fp8 --batch 8` output:
```
median 120ms p95 420ms ttft increase correlated with kvcache eviction_count=172
```

raj: Thanks. i'll run per-kernel timing with nvprof, and run with kv_cache_size=2x to see effect. also try microbatch_window_ms=0 to force immediate flush.

lee: also try toggling `quant.dequant_in_prefill=false` so dequant only on decode path — might reduce prefill overhead for fp8. But check quality.

jess: note: we saw calibration mismatch earlier — ensure calibration used is the same between canary and prod. calibration mismatch can trigger fallback codepaths.

ci-bot: canary deploy reverted on 1778799001 due to latency alert. PR: D+1 rollback candidate.

marta: uploaded flamegraphs to /perf/artifacts/1778801234/ — please review. I also ran int8/hybrid4bit baseline and fp8 is only faster for small seq lengths; long ctx shows dequant penalty.

raj: plan: (1) reproduce with larger kv_cache_size, (2) run microbatch merge, (3) test dequant toggle, (4) run A/B with hybrid-int8. I'll post results.

jess: thanks. assign to raj for next 24h. add timeline to eng-runtime board. :thumbsup:
